'''Roric Goldenfield''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] rancher who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Wait a second. I guess you don't look like a pirate or thug. I'm sorry. I'm so riled up I can hardly think straight. Look, I could use your help with this. My husband has left to contact the authorities. I need to go calm down or I may do something drastic. Please, go down the stairs and keep an eye on those thugs for me. It would really help me out.|[[Helen Goldenfield]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Roric Goldenfield lived in a [[The Ranch|ranch]] near the city of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] with his wife [[Helen Goldenfield]].<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

[[File:Tatooine_ranch.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[The Ranch]].]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Roric had become embattled with a band of [[Sand slum pirates|pirates]] who had set up their [[Pirate Base|base]] near his home on Tatooine. At some point, he managed to capture and imprison two of the pirates, [[Arian Vh'ra]] and [[Itr Fairla]], in his basement, after which he left his home to locate an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] garrison to have them arrested. He left his wife, Helen, to guard the pirates. While he was away, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]], on a [[Quest of the Hero of Tatooine|quest]] to become the [[Hero of Tatooine]], visited his home. Helen asked her guest if they would watch the prisoners while she took a break, to which the spacer agreed. During this time, the pirates tried to persuade the spacer to free them, but they refused and proceeded to tell Helen of their plans to escape. At that same moment, Roric had finally arrived back with two Imperial [[Exogen-class dark trooper|dark troopers]] following. The troopers promptly arrested the pirates and Roric thanked the anonymous spacer for protecting both his home and his wife.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommonerHumanMale.png|thumb|right|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Roric Goldenfield]]
Roric Goldenfield was a non-playable character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Roric Goldenfield was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Hero of Tatooine|"Hero of Tatooine" questline]],<ref name="SWG" /> released with "[[W:c:swg:Publish 9 Notes for 29 June 04|Publish 9]]" on [[June 29]], [[2004]].<ref>{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?page=Recent%20Updates|text=Publish 9 Secrets of the Force}}</ref>

Because Roric Goldenfield spawned under the generic "commoner_human_male" template, his appearance was randomized under one of twelve possible depictions. He appeared consistently a Human male, however.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

The "Hero of Tatooine" questline was extensively revamped upon the introduction of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> but the "Honor" portion involving the Goldenfield family was not altered.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />
